idea-plugin.name: MyBatisProviderJump
idea-plugin.description:
Gutter navigation between MyBatis annotation-based Mapper methods and their SQL provider methods — like MyBatisX's bird icon, but for the annotation style.

Forward — a forward icon appears next to Mapper methods annotated with @SelectProvider / @InsertProvider / @UpdateProvider / @DeleteProvider; click it to jump to the provider method.

Back — a back icon appears next to provider methods; click it to jump back to the referencing Mapper method(s) (a popup list is shown when there are multiple references).

Supported conventions:
• Explicit type/method attributes, or the bare short syntax @SelectProvider(ProviderClass.class)
• Same-name convention: omit method when the provider implements ProviderMethodResolver
• Default provideSql method when the resolver is not implemented
• Overloaded provider methods are matched by the mapper's parameter count
